references.text: Gideon also had a concubine in Shechem, who bore him a son. Both texts mention a concubine (פִּילֶגֶשׁ) in an Israelite context.
Reuben lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine. Both texts deal with adultery or sexual sin involving a concubine.
Tamar was sent back to her father's house. A similar situation where a woman returns to her father's house after problems in marriage.
A woman returning to her father's house is mentioned in connection with the priesthood. Both texts mention returning to one's father's house.
The continuation of the story where the man goes after his concubine to win her back and bring her to her father's house.
Bethlehem in Judah is mentioned as a hometown. The same geographical location reference is used.
A young man from Bethlehem in Judah is mentioned. The same geographical description of Bethlehem in Judah.
